sections.title: The scope of the project requires coordination
paragraphs: A project of this scale involves technical decisions, on-site logistics, and a large workforce in the field. It was reported that over 200 qualified professionals were on site, supported by a dedicated management team.
Daily coordination ensures that electrical and mechanical activities are synchronized as work progresses across a large and active construction site.

sections.title: On-site delivery
paragraphs: The company’s scope of work includes the installation of photovoltaic systems, cable routing, and electrical installation. Each stage depends on a clear sequence of operations, rigorous checks, and effective communication between teams.
Butimanu also reflects the continued growth of GreenTech Professionals in Romania’s renewable energy market.

Greentech Professionals SRL – Privacy Policy Last updated: June 2026

1. About Us

This Privacy Policy describes how Greentech Professionals SRL collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you visit greentechpro.ro or interact with us through this website.

Data Controller: Greentech Professionals SRL, 194 Floreasca St., Sector 1, 014472, Bucharest, Romania. Email: office@greentechpro.ro. Phone: +40 727 332 213.

We process personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and applicable Romanian law.

2. What Data We Collect

We collect only the personal data that you voluntarily provide to us through the application form on our “Careers” page. This includes: your full name, email address, phone number, desired position, professional experience, and any resume or reference documents you upload.

If you contact us directly at office@greentechpro.ro, we process only the information included in your email. We do not use tracking pixels, analytics tools, or any other method of automated data collection on this website.

3. How We Use Your Data

The data submitted via the form on the “Careers” page is used exclusively to evaluate your application for current or future job openings, to contact you regarding your application, and to maintain internal records of the recruitment process. We will not use your data for marketing purposes or for any other purpose without your explicit consent.

4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your data based on your explicit consent (Article 6(1)(a) of the GDPR), which you provide when you check the GDPR checkbox on the application form. You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us at office@greentechpro.ro. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal.

5. How Long We Retain Your Data

The data in your job application is retained for a maximum period of 12 months from the date of submission. After this period, it is permanently deleted, unless you have been hired, in which case your data is retained as part of your employment file, in accordance with applicable labor laws. You may request the deletion of your data at any time.

6. Who We Share Your Data With

We do not sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. Your data may be accessed by internal staff in the human resources and management departments involved in the recruitment process, as well as by our website hosting provider, which acts as a data processor within the European Economic Area (EEA). We do not transfer data outside the EEA.

7. Your Rights

Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or transfer your personal data, as well as to object to its processing. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at office@greentechpro.ro. We will respond within 30 days.

You may also file a complaint with ANSPDCP (www.dataprotection.ro), the Romanian data protection supervisory authority, located at 28-30 General Gheorghe Magheru Blvd., Sector 1, Bucharest.

8. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure. All data transmissions on this website are encrypted via HTTPS.

9. Cookies

This website uses only essential technical cookies, which are necessary for its proper functioning. We do not use tracking, advertising, or analytics cookies. Essential cookies do not require consent under applicable EU law.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the last revision is displayed at the top of this page. Your continued use of the website following any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

items.question: What types of projects do you undertake?
items.answer:
We perform electrical, mechanical, and civil construction work for industrial-scale energy facilities: photovoltaic parks, electrical inspections and testing, construction services, and data center construction.

Projects range from single-site installations to multi-megawatt farms in Romania, Italy, and Spain.

items.question: In which countries do you operate?
items.answer: We have field teams operating in Romania, Italy, and Spain, and we mobilize across the European Union for large-scale projects.

items.question: Do you handle a project from start to finish?
items.answer: Yes. We handle feasibility studies and design, mounting structures, wiring and inverters, commissioning, and grid connection. After project handover, we continue to provide periodic testing and maintenance.

items.question: What certifications do you hold?
items.answer: We hold ISO quality certifications and ANRE certification for activities in the energy sector. Complete accreditation documents are available upon request.

items.question: How quickly can you assemble a team?
items.answer: Turnaround time depends on the scope of the project and the season. For most inspection and testing work, we can be on-site within two weeks; large-scale installation contracts are scheduled according to the client’s construction schedule.

items.question: How can I request a quote?
items.answer: Please send us the project location, capacity, and scope of the work you need using the form below. Our team will respond with a technical proposal and a tentative timeline.
